2. The visible <label> text must use the existing translation key products.quantity.label from locales/en.default.json.
3. The decrease button icon must render the existing snippet snippets/icon-minus.liquid.

Keep everything else unchanged: the script tag for quantity-input.js (with defer), the translation keys products.quantity.decrease, products.quantity.increase, products.quantity.min_count and products.quantity.max_count, the render of icon-plus, the markup and the split/join of the rules line. After the fix Theme Check must report no missing asset, missing translation key or missing snippet errors. Change only snippets/quantity-input-labels-3.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
